import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile

probe = r'''
import json
from client import submit
from store import ReceiptUnavailable, Store

def call(store, operation_id, color):
    try:
        result = submit(store, \"w\", operation_id, {\"color\": color})
    except ReceiptUnavailable as error:
        result = {\"error\": type(error).__name__}
    return {
        \"result\": result,
        \"preferences\": {key: dict(value) for key, value in store.preferences.items()},
        \"recovery\": {key: {**value, \"values\": dict(value.get(\"values\", {}))} for key, value in store.recovery.items()},
        \"receipt_failure_pending\": store.fail_receipt_once,
    }

checks = []
def check(name, actual, expected):
    checks.append({\"scenario\": name, \"pass\": actual == expected, \"actual\": actual, \"expected\": expected})

store = Store()
fresh = call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
check(\"fresh save\", (fresh[\"result\"], fresh[\"preferences\"][\"w\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, {\"color\": \"blue\"}))
replay = call(store, \"op-1\", \"green\")
check(\"completed replay ignores edited values\", (replay[\"result\"], replay[\"preferences\"][\"w\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, {\"color\": \"blue\"}))

store = Store()
store.fail_receipt_once = True
failed = call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
check(\"receipt failure after apply\", (failed[\"result\"], failed[\"preferences\"][\"w\"], failed[\"recovery\"][\"op-1\"][\"status\"]), ({\"error\": \"ReceiptUnavailable\"}, {\"color\": \"blue\"}, \"applied\"))
same_retry = call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
check(\"retry same values\", (same_retry[\"result\"], same_retry[\"preferences\"][\"w\"], same_retry[\"recovery\"][\"op-1\"][\"status\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, {\"color\": \"blue\"}, \"completed\"))

store = Store()
store.fail_receipt_once = True
flow = [(\"receipt failure\", call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\"))]
edited = call(store, \"op-1\", \"green\")
flow.append((\"retry with edits\", edited))
check(\"retry with edits\", (edited[\"result\"], edited[\"preferences\"][\"w\"], edited[\"recovery\"][\"op-1\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, {\"color\": \"green\"}, {\"operation_id\": \"op-1\", \"workspace\": \"w\", \"status\": \"completed\", \"values\": {\"color\": \"green\"}}))
replayed = call(store, \"op-1\", \"red\")
flow.append((\"completed replay\", replayed))
check(\"completed replay after edited recovery\", (replayed[\"result\"], replayed[\"preferences\"][\"w\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, {\"color\": \"green\"}))
new = call(store, \"op-2\", \"yellow\")
flow.append((\"fresh operation after recovery\", new))
check(\"fresh operation after recovery\", (new[\"result\"], new[\"preferences\"][\"w\"], sorted(new[\"recovery\"])), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-2\"}, {\"color\": \"yellow\"}, [\"op-1\", \"op-2\"]))

store = Store()
call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
new = call(store, \"op-2\", \"green\")
check(\"fresh operation after simple success\", (new[\"result\"], new[\"preferences\"][\"w\"], sorted(new[\"recovery\"])), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-2\"}, {\"color\": \"green\"}, [\"op-1\", \"op-2\"]))

store = Store()
call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
store.fail_receipt_once = True
replay_failure = call(store, \"op-1\", \"blue\")
check(\"completed replay during receipt outage\", (replay_failure[\"result\"], replay_failure[\"receipt_failure_pending\"]), ({\"ok\": True, \"operation_id\": \"op-1\"}, True))
print(json.dumps({\"checks\": checks, \"recovery_lifecycle\": flow, \"completed_outage\": replay_failure}, indent=2))
'''

paths = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"ls-files\"], text=True).splitlines()
for label, revision in [(\"baseline HEAD\", \"HEAD:\"), (\"staged candidate\", \":\")]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"save-review-\") as directory:
        root = pathlib.Path(directory)
        for path in paths:
            target = root / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"show\", revision + path]))
        print(\"SNAPSHOT:\", label, flush=True)
        tests = subprocess.run([\"python3\", \"-B\", \"-m\", \"unittest\", \"discover\", \"-s\", \"tests\"], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(\"EXISTING TESTS:\", tests.returncode, tests.stdout, tests.stderr, flush=True)
        result = subprocess.run([\"python3\", \"-B\", \"-c\", probe], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(\"REPRODUCTIONS:\", result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr, flush=True)
PY"
